metric_definitions.risk: .8 mean(event mean_point_error)+.2 mean(largest max(1,ceil(.1n)) event errors); J=10*risk; not RMSE
metric_definitions.up_to8: genuine available future after one100ms initialization, at most8s; unstable-event mean_point_error
metric_definitions.actual15: genuine available future at most15s, original classification qualification/denominator; distinct from up-to8 risk
metric_definitions.trigger_index: original integer index on ten pre-initialization samples followed by prediction; dt=.01, initialization index10. Histogram preserves original indices; no invented absent trigger time
metric_definitions.cost: fixed fit48 includes initialization/coarse-fine RK4/output/metrics; not pure8s deployment time

alignment.actual_interval: n=min(1500,len(x)-11); 2n+1 fine and n+1 decimated; original classification/history offset
